mapper.insert: INSERT INTO otps_product ( id, shop_id, name, category, price, stock, image_url, remark, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{product.id}, #{product.shopId}, #{product.name}, #{product.category}, #{product.price}, #{product.stock}, #{product.imageUrl}, #{product.remark}, #{product.status}, #{product.createTime}, #{product.updateTime} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE otps_product
name = #{product.name},
category = #{product.category},
price = #{product.price},
stock = #{product.stock},
image_url = #{product.imageUrl},
remark = #{product.remark},
status = #{product.status},
update_time = SYSDATE
WHERE id = #{product.id} AND shop_id = #{product.shopId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM otps_product WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.shop_id, p.name, p.category, d1.enum_name AS category_name, p.price, p.stock, p.image_url, p.remark, p.status, d2.enum_name AS status_name, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM otps_product p LEFT JOIN otps_dict d1 ON d1.dict_id = 'product:category' AND d1.enum_code = p.category LEFT JOIN otps_dict d2 ON d2.dict_id = 'product:status' AND d2.enum_code = p.status WHERE p.id = #{id}
